contracts.source: NetApp press release: NetApp and Supermicro Collaborate to Power AI at Any Scale (09-29-2026)
contracts.signal: NetApp announced a strategic collaboration with Supermicro to deliver jointly validated AI infrastructure solutions spanning large-scale AI factories, enterprise deployments, neoclouds, and sovereign AI initiatives, combining Supermicro's AI-optimized compute and rack-scale systems with the NetApp Platform. As the initial implementation, NetApp and Supermicro will deliver NetApp Novus Data Director software running on qualified Supermicro servers with NetApp AFF A90 systems as the high-performance ONTAP data layer, which NetApp calls 'the first step in a broader collaboration to co-engineer integrated infrastructure solutions'. The companies are also collaborating on NetApp AIPod with Supermicro, a NetApp-validated converged infrastructure architecture based on the NVIDIA Reference Architecture guidance, delivered through NetApp's channel partners, for AI training, inference, and agentic workloads 'from dozens to hundreds of GPUs'.
contracts.units: AIPod with Supermicro: from dozens to hundreds of GPUs
